text:
uname -a
mount
id
cat /proc/modules
ls -l /sys/bus/pci/devices/0000:00:01.1
cat /sys/bus/pci/devices/0000:00:01.1/modalias
cat /proc/partitions

ls -l /sys/bus/pci /sys/bus/pci/devices /sys/devices/pci0000:00
ls /sys/bus/pci/drivers
cat /proc/bus/pci/devices
modprobe -v ata_piix
modprobe -v sr_mod
cat /proc/partitions

printf "Alpine initramfs recovery: boot media missing\n" >/dev/tty1
uname -a | tee -a /dev/tty1
mount | tee -a /dev/tty1
mount -t tracefs tracefs /sys/kernel/tracing
ls /sys/kernel/tracing
cat /sys/bus/pci/devices/0000:00:00.0/uevent

cd /sys/kernel/tracing
echo 'r:devadd device_add ret=$retval:s64' >> kprobe_events
echo 'r:pciadd pci_device_add ret=$retval:s64' >> kprobe_events
echo 'r:syslink sysfs_do_create_link_sd ret=$retval:s64' >> kprobe_events
echo 'r:kernnode __kernfs_new_node ret=$retval:s64' >> kprobe_events
echo 1 > events/kprobes/enable
echo 1 > /sys/bus/pci/rescan
echo 0 > events/kprobes/enable
cat trace
ls /sys/bus/pci/devices

echo > /sys/kernel/tracing/kprobe_events
cd /
ls -l /dev/sr0
nlplug-findfs -p /sbin/mdev -d -b /tmp/repositories -a /tmp/apkovls
cat /tmp/repositories
mount

cat /sys/firmware/acpi/interrupts/gpe01
dd if=/dev/port bs=1 skip=45024 count=4 2>/dev/null | hexdump -C
dd if=/dev/port bs=1 skip=44544 count=16 2>/dev/null | hexdump -C
exit

echo APK_DEFAULT
apk --root /sysroot --repository /media/cdrom/apks --no-network update
echo APK_BASELINE
OPENSSL_ia32cap=0:0 apk --root /sysroot --repository /media/cdrom/apks --no-network update
echo APK_NO_EXTENDED
OPENSSL_ia32cap=:0 apk --root /sysroot --repository /media/cdrom/apks --no-network update

echo OPENSSL_DIAGNOSTIC
ls /media/cdrom/apks/x86_64/openssl-*.apk
tar -xzf /media/cdrom/apks/x86_64/openssl-*.apk -C /tmp usr/bin/openssl
sha256sum /etc/apk/keys/*6165ee59*
tar -xzf /media/cdrom/apks/x86_64/APKINDEX.tar.gz -C /tmp
tail -c +723 /media/cdrom/apks/x86_64/APKINDEX.tar.gz >/tmp/index.data
/tmp/usr/bin/openssl dgst -sha1 /tmp/index.data
/tmp/usr/bin/openssl dgst -sha1 -verify /etc/apk/keys/alpine-devel@lists.alpinelinux.org-6165ee59.rsa.pub -signature /tmp/.SIGN.RSA.alpine-devel@lists.alpinelinux.org-6165ee59.rsa.pub /tmp/index.data

printf "\033[2J\033[HAlpine initramfs: APK signature verification failed\n" > /dev/tty1
(uname -a; id; mount) | tee -a /dev/tty1
